faqs.q: Will seat covers affect side airbag deployment?
faqs.a: We use airbag-compatible seat covers with specific seam provisions where required for your vehicle model.

faqs.q: Are the covers machine washable?
faqs.a: Most leatherette covers are wipe-clean. Fabric covers may be removable for washing depending on the design.

faqs.q: Can I choose a custom colour combination?
faqs.a: Yes, two-tone and custom colour combinations with contrasting stitching are available.

faqs.q: How long does installation take?
faqs.a: Installation time varies depending on the vehicle model and cover type. We recommend discussing timing during your enquiry.
